kill_argument: The causal claim remains entirely hostage to unverified selection on observables: this voluntary synthetic cohort supplies no assignment mechanism establishing equal untreated potential earnings. I attacked the design for treating balance or a preprogram placebo as proof of identification, silently changing the ATT under poor support, and using nonsignificance as equivalence. Those attacks do not defeat the written design: it explicitly conditions interpretation on exchangeability, blocks affirmative conclusions under fixed support failures, labels capping as sensitivity, and fixes valid distinct zero-effect and benchmark-equivalence decisions with a joint multiplicity family. Rejection as an unconditional historical evaluation would be warranted; that is not the contribution actually specified. The strongest remaining objection is that H2 still calls the arbitrary supplied-unit bound substantive and promises a design-stage precision assessment that the run schedule postpones until after the primary outcome analysis.

findings.text: H2 calls 1000 a substantive benchmark and requires its power/scale assessment before analysis, while design.data.scale correctly disclaims substantive calibration and analysis_plan puts precision-plan after main-att. Align H2 with supplied-unit benchmark equivalence and make the outcome-free precision grid precede main-att (or explicitly withdraw the before-analysis promise). Resolution requires consistent wording and run ordering, not new outcome data or a changed bound.
findings.response: Prospective Designer response (before seed analysis; no reviewer ruling): H2 is benchmark equivalence in supplied earnings units. Its phrase substantive benchmark denotes the fixed declared benchmark only; there is no independently established currency, price base, welfare calibration or smallest economically meaningful effect. The bound stays [-1000,1000]. Execute precision-plan before main-att: its grid uses fixed hypothetical variances/counts, and its authorized re74/re75 scale descriptors supply context without reading re78 or tuning any bound, model or test. Main-att remains the first postprogram outcome-analysis run. Baseline scale assessment cannot establish welfare relevance; report that limitation regardless of precision. See plan.json design.prospective_clarifications. Finding status and ruling remain for the independent Reviewer.

findings.text: Validation requires a known region category, but the codebook and schema correctly say no external region vocabulary exists. This leaves the stop rule ambiguous: the data-prep validity flag cannot establish source-defined category validity. Explicitly authorize the four documented observed labels as the fixed encoding vocabulary, or narrow validation to nonmissing categorical labels with this metadata limitation. Resolution requires a prospective validation clarification; no outcome analysis is needed.

findings.response: Prospective Designer response (before seed analysis; no reviewer ruling): For operational validation and fixed dummy encoding, known nonmissing region means exactly one of the schema-documented observed labels midwest, northeast, south, west; omit midwest lexicographically. This vocabulary was documented during schema-only data preparation, not chosen from outcome relationships. Reject missing, new or changed labels and do not repair/drop rows or alter the full-cohort ATT. This checks consistency with the hash-pinned extract, not independent source-defined semantic validity; no external vocabulary exists in supplied metadata. Retain that limitation in the paper. See plan.json design.prospective_clarifications. Finding status and ruling remain for the independent Reviewer.
